supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; holdout with X1,X2,X3 gives test R2 0.765 vs 0.772 with X4,X5 added.
Interaction coef 0.749, p=1.5e-18, delta_r2 0.0735 in X4/X5-only model; holdout test R2 rises from 0.772 to 0.878 when X4:X5 is added (train 0.888), so the gain generalizes.
Main effect coef 0.18, p=1.5e-5 in the full additive model; likely partly reflects the X4:X5 interaction.
Main effect coef 0.147, p=4e-4 in the full additive model; likely partly reflects the X4:X5 interaction.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant interaction (p=1.5e-18) and a large out-of-sample R2 improvement (0.772 to 0.878).

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression association only; no experimental or design evidence for causation.
Strong association but no basis to infer causation from regression alone.
Effect appears conditional on X5; association only.
Effect appears conditional on X4; association only.
